categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). There is no government personnel or structural changes, legal/regulatory framework creation, or other specialized administrative matters that would warrant a different classification.
